title: E=mc² ↔ i ↔ E=mc⁻² Checksum and 6D Octonion Interior
summary: Closes gaps 8 (consciousness) and 9 (codon routing) through the E=mc²↔i↔E=mc⁻² checksum and the 6D octonion interior. The octonion splits into 6D interior (e1-e6) + 2D boundary (e0, e7). The 1/8 consciousness fraction = 1/(6+2) = boundary/total. The 64 codons = 2^6 = information content of the 6D interior. The E=mc²↔i↔E=mc⁻² checksum provides the physics mechanism: forward (mass→energy) and inverse (energy→mass) propagations through the 6D interior, with i (e7=0^0) as the self-referential pivot. The Möbius/Smith chart transformation Γ=(z-1)/(z+1) is the mathematical expression of this checksum.
